title: Pairwise additivity for three particles at rest on an equilateral triangle of side 5 (species A, B, C and A, A, A)

claims.statement: Three particles at rest on the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side 5.0, species A, B, C: the pairwise sum over partners of the P-0005 coefficients (no three-body term) reproduces the tracker positions to T = 1.5 at tracker-noise level. Residual rms per coordinate 0.049 and 0.051 (2026-11-19/r1/lab-a/001-002). The zero-force null gives 0.12 on the same runs. The pre-registered rule (residual rms at most 0.07, null above 0.09) passed. Sides shrink to 4.6-5.5 by t = 1.5.

Three species-A particles at rest on an equilateral triangle of side 5.0: the pairwise sum (A-A coefficient 18.0 from P-0003) reproduces the tracker positions to T = 1.5 at noise level, residual rms 0.047 and 0.048 per coordinate (2026-11-19/r1/lab-a/003-004). The zero-force null gives 0.22. Sides shrink to 3.8 by t = 1.5, so the claim covers separations 3.75-5.0 only. The integrator is sensitive at separations near 3.5; this run uses step 0.002.
